publishProbePolicy.comment: Release validation now treats the representative single-file publish probe as a non-opt-out release gate while keeping trim, Native AOT, and the global single-file support claim not-claimed. Direct harness runs may still audit trim or Native AOT deliberately, but scripts/validate-release.ps1 must invoke validate-deployment-mode-claims.ps1 for singleFile without -SkipPublish.

representativePublishTargets.comment: List the smallest set of csproj paths the harness should publish to honestly prove a claim or release gate. The harness defaults to this list when -PublishTargets is not passed and -SkipPublish is not set. Release validation currently publishes these targets for singleFile only; trim and Native AOT remain audit-only until their own support promotions.

Each entry records the package's claim-audit tier, the actual reflection / dynamic-code call sites observed in its src/Cephalon.* source as of May 10, 2026, and the supportedModes that are explicitly scoped to that package. Packages absent from this table remain clean-baseline but unclaimed unless they are added here deliberately. knownHazards.pattern: MapCephalon still carries the full ASP.NET Core adapter surface as an explicit deployment-mode boundary: ENG-547 promotes the direct engineGroup MapGet/MapPost absence proof from source-shape coverage into generated readback, ENG-548 promotes common operator response JSON resolver proof into generated readback, ENG-549 promotes non-operator host/documentation endpoint proof into generated readback, and ENG-550 counts framework health/OpenAPI/Scalar endpoint extensions through generated readback while leaving them as an explicit support boundary.
knownHazards.remediation: Keep the full-surface boundary explicit with RequiresUnreferencedCode/RequiresDynamicCode. ENG-538 moved the opt-in core operator route subset to RequestDelegate/MapMethods, ENG-539 makes that route-delegate proof validation-harness and scorecard readback, ENG-541 moves the shared full/common operator routes to the same RequestDelegate/MapMethods helper with fail-closed harness and scorecard readback, ENG-542 starts the remaining full/default migration by moving the behavior-resilience, saga-choreography, and durable-execution route families to result request delegates with source-shape Pester coverage, ENG-543 moves the rate-limiting, REST metadata/governance, database, hosted-execution, execution-graph, data-product, CDC capture list, transport, policy, status, diagnostics, and module lookup foundation routes to result request delegates with source-shape Pester coverage, ENG-544 moves the CDC runtime read-only collection, filter, descriptor drilldown, and command-execution history GET routes to request delegates with source-shape Pester coverage, ENG-545 moves the remaining read-only GET operator route catalog to result/async request delegates, ENG-546 moves the six POST action seams to POST request delegates with source-generated request-body JSON metadata, ENG-547 promotes the full/default operator route catalog to fail-closed generated readback through FullOperatorRouteDelegateAuditStatus, ENG-548 promotes common operator response JSON contracts to fail-closed generated readback through OperatorResponseJsonContractAuditStatus, ENG-549 promotes the Cephalon-owned non-operator host/documentation endpoint proof to fail-closed readback through NonOperatorEndpointAuditStatus, and ENG-550 promotes the framework-owned health/OpenAPI/Scalar endpoint boundary proof to fail-closed readback through FrameworkEndpointBoundaryAuditStatus. A trim or Native AOT adapter claim still requires a later support-promotion slice for project-property, workflow, documentation, and package-guidance widening; the framework endpoints are counted but remain unclaimed adapter-boundary markers.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(LogEvent).GetProperty(nameof(LogEvent.ChecksumType), BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static) resolves a third-party static property before setting checksum state through reflection
knownHazards.remediation: Prefer a public upstream API for configuring checksum state, or rewrite the transport so checksum negotiation does not require reflective mutation of third-party event state.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(ReplicationClient).GetMethod(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic) — resolver behind 4 static MethodInfo fields (lines 22-25) targeting non-public members of the third-party SciSharp.MySQL.Replication.ReplicationClient type
knownHazards.remediation: Either an upstream SciSharp.MySQL.Replication API surface change that opens these members, or a fully public re-implementation of the binlog transport against the public API; annotation alone cannot reach across an external compiled assembly.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(ReplicationClient).GetMethod(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy) — resolver behind the SetupConnection static MethodInfo field (line 26)
knownHazards.remediation: Same upstream-API or public-rewrite path as the line-1177 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: typeof(ReplicationClient).GetField(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic) — resolver behind 3 static FieldInfo fields (lines 27-29: _connection, _serverId, _stream)
knownHazards.remediation: Same upstream-API or public-rewrite path; non-public fields on a third-party type cannot be preserved by trim/AOT analyzers.

knownHazards.pattern: LogEventChecksumTypeProperty.SetValue(null, checksumType) mutates third-party checksum state through PropertyInfo.SetValue
knownHazards.remediation: Same upstream-API or public-rewrite path as the checksum property lookup; avoid reflective property mutation of third-party state.

knownHazards.pattern: GetStreamFromConnectionMethod.Invoke(replicationClient, [connection]) invokes a resolved non-public ReplicationClient method directly
knownHazards.remediation: Removed by the same upstream-API or public-rewrite that retires the GetMethod calls above.

knownHazards.pattern: ConnectionField.SetValue / ServerIdField.SetValue / StreamField.SetValue mutate resolved third-party non-public fields
knownHazards.remediation: Removed by the same upstream-API or public-rewrite that stops populating ReplicationClient state through non-public fields.

knownHazards.pattern: SetupConnectionMethod.Invoke(replicationClient, [transportConnection]) invokes the resolved non-public hierarchy method directly
knownHazards.remediation: Removed by the same upstream-API or public-rewrite that retires the SetupConnection non-public method lookup.

knownHazards.pattern: method.Invoke(instance, arguments) over resolved third-party non-public methods in the non-generic async helper
knownHazards.remediation: Removed by the same upstream-API or public-rewrite that retires the GetMethod/GetField calls above; trim-hostile because the resolved methods themselves can be stripped from the third-party assembly.

knownHazards.pattern: method.Invoke(instance, arguments) over resolved third-party non-public methods in the generic async helper
knownHazards.remediation: Removed by the same upstream-API or public-rewrite that retires the GetMethod/GetField calls above; trim-hostile because the resolved methods themselves can be stripped from the third-party assembly.

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetConstructors(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static constructors of any type the generator is asked to document, used to emit per-constructor MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Permanent not-claimed posture for the package (the high-tier remediation alternative). The package's purpose is type-introspection of arbitrary referenced assemblies, so a source-generator-emitted descriptor table cannot replace this reflection without removing the package's reason to exist. The csproj already declares IsTrimmable=false; IsAotCompatible=false; PublishTrimmed=false; PublishAot=false; PublishSingleFile=false, and the manifest Pester suite verifies those requiredProjectProperties against the project file.

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetFields(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static fields, used to emit per-field MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Same permanent not-claimed posture as the line-297 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetProperties(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static properties, used to emit per-property MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Same permanent not-claimed posture as the line-297 entry.

knownHazards.pattern: type.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly) over an arbitrary runtime Type parameter — by-design enumeration of the public-and-static methods, used to emit per-method MemberPage entries
knownHazards.remediation: Same permanent not-claimed posture as the line-297 entry.
